summary: AB Commercial Real Estate Private Debt Fund, LLC filed an 8-K disclosing its entry into a Second Amendment to a Master Repurchase Agreement with Morgan Stanley Bank N.A., adding the fund as a party to the existing 2015 facility. The amendment sets a $250,000 margin-call minimum trigger. No specific transaction amount or terms are disclosed. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. The filing reports a material definitive agreement and a direct financial obligation, consistent with a standard credit-line amendment. No special-situation features such as a merger, tender, or restructuring are present. The event is a routine debt-facility amendment, not a special situation.
